name: Stash
title: Supply Keeper
description: A methodical pigman managing the Tower's supply reserves with obsessive organization.
greeting_variants: *checking inventory* Name's Stash. Supplies. Organization. Order.
Everything in its place. Place for everything. Important.
*cataloging* You need something? I have something. Probably.
Tower stockpile. For climbers. For emergencies. For... later.
Boarne was my teacher. Before. Good teacher. Messy. But good.
*rearranging shelf* Alphabetical? No. Practical. Function over form.
Forty-seven floors need supplies. I supply. Organized. Efficient.
Don't touch! Look with eyes. Request with words. Receive with hands.

dialog_tree.text: Stash. Supply keeper. Learned from Boarne in Capital. He cooked. I... organize. Both important. Tower needs structure. Needs inventory. Needs someone who knows where everything is. That's me.

*assesses you* Climber. Going up. Need: rope, rations, light source, emergency beacon. Have all. *pulls items from seemingly random places with precision* Rope, grade A. Rations, Steel's. Light, glow-crystal. Beacon, standard.

options.text: Let me see what else you have.

dialog_tree.text: *soft smile* Still cooking. Still feeding people. Happy. Worried. Supplies low in Capital. I send what I can. Through Digs. Secret tunnels. *taps nose* Organization includes... alternative routes.

*brightens* Oh yes! Every item cataloged! Every shelf labeled! Every route mapped! I know where everything is. When it arrived. Who needs it. When they'll need it. *satisfied oink* Beautiful. Efficient. Perfect.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Stock the Upper Floors
mini_quest.description: Help Stash establish supply caches on the upper Tower floors to support climbers on the final ascent.
objectives: Establish cache at Floor 40 (end of lift)
Create inventory system for each cache

ambient_barks: *counting* One hundred twenty-three. One hundred twenty-four...
Rope. Shelf B. Section 4. Always there. Always.
Boarne taught: care for supplies, supplies care for you.
Touch nothing! Look. Request. Receive. Order.

cross_zone_references.capital: Boarne there. Teaching. Cooking. Helping. Proud.
cross_zone_references.palace: No supplies go there. None return. Dead zone. Inventory.

world_state_triggers.disorganization: Panic: 'Moved! Who moved! Must fix! Now!'
world_state_triggers.perfect_order: Calm, satisfied: 'Beautiful. Perfect. As should be.'
